name: Product Characteristics 1 Code
definition: Specifies the charateristics of a product.

BISP.name: Buyers Item Specification
BISP.definition: Detailed product information as assigned by the buyer.

CHNR.name: Chassis Number
CHNR.definition: Unique identifier affixed by manufacturer to a chassis for identification purposes.

EDSP.name: Engine Displacement
EDSP.definition: The total of the volume used for combustion inside the cylinders of an engine. This is expressed in cubic centimetres.

ENNR.name: Engine Number
ENNR.definition: Unique identifier affixed by manufacturer to an engine for identification purposes.

OPTN.name: Option
OPTN.definition: Identifier of a sub-category of a product such as size, colour, etc.

ORCR.name: Origin Criterion
ORCR.definition: Code assigned to the product describing how it will be stored.

SISP.name: Sellers Item Specification
SISP.definition: Detailed product information as assigned by the seller.

STOR.name: Storage Code
STOR.definition: Code assigned to the product describing how it will be stored.

VINR.name: Vehicle Identification Number
VINR.definition: The identification number which uniquely distinguishes one vehicle from another through the lifespan of the vehicle.
